fact_text: An off-market transaction is a negotiated trade in which buyer and seller already know each other and instruct the broker to execute a fixed block, unlike a ready-market order that matches anonymously.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: In the ready market buyer and seller identities stay confidential, while in off-market trades both parties know each other before the trade is reported to the exchange.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Off-market trades can be member-to-member between brokerage houses, or client-to-client between two clients of the same house, with both sides arranged before execution.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: In the ready market a single-day price premium is capped at about 10% above the market, while off-market trades have no circuit-breaker limit on the price agreed by the two parties.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Under the PSX rule book a party arranging an off-market trade must inform the exchange of the quantity it wants to trade, and the agreed price may sit well away from the day's market price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: The analyst argues large blocks in illiquid stocks can trigger panic selling by other holders in the ready market, so a seller may prefer a negotiated off-market window that leaves the price undisturbed.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Off-market windows can help short sellers caught in upper-circuit rallies buy back the shares they owe; the analyst says he neither promotes nor recommends short selling.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Before board elections a party seeking a majority stake may buy a large block off-market at a premium of about 10% over market, to hold a controlling position and return the shares later.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Off-market buyers can obtain stock at a discount, and sellers who need cash for a large block can receive it at once; the analyst lists these as main motives alongside market-impact avoidance.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: In the published off-market report a plus sign marks the buying side and a minus sign the selling side; each line gives the stock symbol, the traded quantity and the agreed price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: To read an off-market print, compare its price with the same day's ready-market price: a print above market suggests premium demand, while a print well below market may signal negative news or overvaluation.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: In an off-market trade reported for 27 May 2025, Arif Habib Limited bought 500 shares from Spectrum Securities at Rs 180 each; the stock itself is not clearly named in the transcript.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: In the illustration a stock that fell to PKR 30-40 and was sold at PKR 80 kept rising through upper circuits to PKR 90, 100 and 110, squeezing a short seller who waited for a fall.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: In the illustration a buyer aiming for PKR 1,000 could average PKR 1,500 in the open market after repeated upper circuits, so he looks for a seller off-market.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Off-market trades have no circuit breaker or price cap, so a PKR 100 stock can trade at PKR 140 off-market, while the same day's ready-market rate stays within the daily limit.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Arif Habib Limited has PSX member code 050, and every member house has its own code shown in off-market trade data, which the analyst said matters little to retail investors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: Growth Securities bought 11,000 UBL shares at PKR 518 from First Equity Modaraba in an off-market deal reported on 31 May 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)

fact_text: A large off-market trade in PF Biosciences at PKR 160 while the ready market traded at PKR 180 may signal negative news, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Off Market Transactions in PSX | Why They Happen & What Retail Investors Must Know' (YouTube, 2025-05-31)
